draft.executive_summary: Headline CPI inflation was broadly stable at 3.4% year-on-year in August 2026, while the unemployment rate stood unchanged at 4.1%. Retail sales increased by 1.2% month-over-month in August 2026 following −0.5% in the prior month. Real GDP expanded at an annualised quarterly rate of 1.5% in 2026 Q2, down from 2.1% in the preceding quarter. The effective federal funds rate was 3.88% on 24 September 2026, unchanged from the previous observation.
